Forms
  • Create a brand new form using plain English
  • Update form settings and submit button text

Fields

  • Update an existing field (label, required, options…)
  • Discover which field types are available

Lead Forms
Create an embeddable form with multiple page breaks. Your form will be restructured to include a page break between each field so users only see one field at a time as they progress through the form. You can publish this form in a post, page, or widget area. Learn more about Lead Forms.
Export / Import Style Settings

If you've copied style settings from another lead form, you can paste them here to add the same styling to this form. Any current style settings will be overwritten. See our lead form styling documentation for details.

Easily Create Interactive Quizzes

Add multiple choice, true/false, or checkbox questions, set correct answers, and automatically score submissions. It’s perfect for educational content, lead generation, or engaging your audience with fun, self-grading quizzes. Learn More

Enable Quiz
  • Graded Quiz
    Score-based quiz with right and wrong answers. Results show total score.
  • Personality Quiz
    No right answers. Results are based on answer patterns and mapped outcomes.
  • Weighted Quiz
    Each answer has a custom point value. Results are based on total score range.

Build Smarter, Not Harder

Need a hand getting started? Explore our quiz templates to build and publish your quiz faster than ever.

Form Locker
Form Verification
Require users to enter information before accessing the form.
 
 
 
Form Scheduling
Accept form entries during a specific date/time period.
 
Form Restrictions
Restrict form access to only those who meet your criteria.
 
Entry Limits & Restrictions
Limit the number of entries and restrict by email or IP address.
 
 
Save and Resume
Allow users to save their progress and resume submitting this form later. A link will be sent to the user which will allow them to simply return to this form with their progress intact. Sensitive information like credit cards and file uploads will not be saved and the user will have to re-enter them. Read more about Save and Resume.
Disclaimer Page
This page is displayed before the user actually commits to saving their progress.
 
Confirmation Page
This page is displayed once the user clicks the Save and Resume link and provides instructions for resuming.
 
Email Settings
When the user chooses to email a link, they are shown the following success message and receive an email with the link.
Thank you for saving Form Name. Click the link below to resume the form from any device. Resume Link Remember, the link should not be shared and will expire in 30 days.
